issue.title: Bug: Uninitialized port role causes SerDes SI skip when role is missing from port config

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

The following PR introduced a change in orchagent where SerDes SI configuration is skipped for ports with certain roles: [PR #4543](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/4543).

However, not all platforms define role for ports in port_config.ini / CONFIG_DB. When role is missing, orchagent still copies PortConfig::role.value into Port::m_role without checking whether role was set, and role.value has no default initializer. The effective role therefore depends on whatever value happens to be in memory at port init, and can end up as Port::Role::Rec or Port::Role::Inb — roles for which PR#4543 skips SerDes programming.

On affected systems, xcvrd may publish media SI settings to APPL_DB, but orchagent never applies them to SAI because programSerdes() returns early. Setting role=Ext in CONFIG_DB (or defaulting missing role to Ext in orchagent) fixes the issue.

### Steps to Reproduce

Note: This bug is non-deterministic. When role is missing from port config, m_role is uninitialized; you cannot predict or observe its value without extra debugging. The skip in PR#4543 only appears when that value happens to be Rec or Inb.

1. Platform with no role in port_config.ini / CONFIG_DB (redis-cli -n 4 HGET "PORT|Ethernet8" role → (nil)).
2. Image with PR#4543, no default of missing role to Ext.
3. Boot with modules that use xcvrd media SI.
Because m_role is uninitialized when role is absent, SerDes may or may not be skipped on a given boot. On affected boots, look for: oper-down ports with SI in APPL_DB, Skipping serdes programming for recirc/inband port, and no serdes SAI logs.

Workaround confirms cause: HSET PORT|Ethernet8 role Ext + swss restart → SerDes programs reliably.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual
* Ports without role in config may end up as Port::Role::Rec or Port::Role::Inb due to lack of initialization, so SerDes SI configuration for those ports is skipped (PR#4543).
Xcvrd may still publish SI to APPL_DB; orchagent does not apply it when the skip path is taken.

Expected
* Only ports whose role is explicitly Rec or Inb should have SerDes SI configuration skipped.

Suggested fix
* Default missing role to Ext in orchagent (e.g. validatePortConfig(), addPortBulk(), initExistingPort(), and/or PortConfig::role.value initializer).

### Relevant log output

```shell
doPortTask: KEY: Ethernet8, OP: SET
FIELD: pre1, VALUE: 0xfffffffe,0xfffffffe,0xfffffffe,0xfffffffe
programSerdes: Skipping serdes programming for recirc/inband port Ethernet8

sudo grep -iE "Created port serdes|Successfully set.*serdes|mlnx_create_port_serdes" /var/log/syslog
# (empty)
```

resolution.title: Set default port role to external
resolution.description:
**What I did**
Default PortConfig::role and Port::m_role to Ext.
Update unit tests to cover ports without an explicit role.

**Why I did it**
Port roles were left uninitialized when the role field was absent from port_config.ini. This could misidentify front-panel ports as inband or recirculation ports, skipping SerDes programming and causing subsequent warm-reboot reconciliation failures.

**How I verified it**
Verified that the Arista-7050CX3-32S-C32 retrieves preemphasis configurations from ASIC_DB when a role is omitted in port_config.ini and values are required from media_settings.json:
202511 with internal review build:
```shell
admin@ld495:/tmp$ show version | grep "SONiC Software Version"
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.branch.202511-ars.bb776d89-buildimage.origin.202511-review.800778.3-2026.09.11.16.37
admin@ld495:/tmp$ sonic-db-cli ASIC_DB HGETALL ASIC_STATE:SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT_SERDES:oid:0x57000000000651
{'SAI_PORT_SERDES_ATTR_PORT_ID': 'oid:0x1000000000012', 'SAI_PORT_SERDES_ATTR_PREEMPHASIS': '4:404995,404995,404995,404995'}
```
